pkgmetadata.longdescription: zmx is a session attach/detach tool for the terminal (a modern tmux alternative). It persists terminal shell sessions, lets you attach and detach without killing them, supports multiple clients per session, and restores the previous terminal state and scrollback on re-attach using libghostty-vt. It is written in Zig. It does not provide windows, tabs, or splits, deferring window management to the OS.
